name: LinkHub
description: LinkHub is a “link-in-bio” platform that lets you organize and manage your links, whether they’re social media profiles, websites, or other content. Users can also create multiple profiles under a single account, making it easy to separate personal, professional, or themed links.

name: Yellow Store
description: Yellow Store is a mini e-commerce application built with Next.js and Supabase, featuring Midtrans payment integration, realtime order updates, and a secure admin dashboard with Supabase authentication.

name: JobMatchAI
description: Job Match AI is an intelligent application that helps match candidates with suitable jobs using AI, featuring a fast backend, real-time updates, and efficient data management.

name: Circle App
description: Circle is a social media app that lets you create your own circle, follow friends, and share threads. Perfect for communities and interest groups.
